title: Willie Bryant band personnel and entertainment style
summary: Ramirez names the band's saxophones, trumpets and Willie's singing, saying it mainly entertained and solos were short.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: But still, after all you were only 22 then. So you could take those things more in your stride, couldn't you.
[PAUSE]
Let's see... I don't think I can convey it the way it is in my mind...
Well, you're doing fine.
If you could see it the way I see it... I don't have the words for...
Well, Willie Bryant's band... Who was in it when you were in it? Who were the stars?
Cozy Cole...
Drums, yeah.
Ben Webster.
Oh, Ben was in it.
Johnny Russell.
Johnny Russell was on tenor, too.
Yeah. Also Charlie Frazier.
Did he play the alto?
He played everything -- tenor, flute, alto. And Stanley Payne.
Ramirez - 50
Who was the lead alto? Stanley?
Stanley.
I see. The trumpets were whom?
Dick Clark. Mmm, we had...
Was Edgar Battle in there then? He was in the earlier band, wasn't he?
Dick Clark?
Edgar Battle.
Joe Thomas.
Oh, Joe Thomas was in the band.
And then the first year was...oh, I forget; he became an undertaker later on.
But anyway, these we can look up. But Willie did a good bit of singing, didn't he?
Yeah, singing and entertaining.
And what would you be featured on in this band? Do you remember?
I don't remember any... But the thing is that the band did a lot of just, like, entertaining, and that's what they went for, you know.
Yeah. And also, in the bands in those days, I mean, you did eight bars sort of thing. The solos weren't like they are today really, stretched out all over the place.
The solos came only if accidentally the people
Ramirez - 51
began to get into the act.
Oh, if you wanted to stretch it out a bit.
Yeah.
